description: This file defines a singly linked list data structure with methods for adding, removing, retrieving size, and accessing elements by index.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A class implementing a singly linked list for storing strings, with methods for modification and access.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: A private nested class representing nodes in the linked list, containing string data and a reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element at the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at a specified index.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Removes a node from the list by updating references.
